items.note: garden goods resist the garden tax — the village subsidizes its own cure
bugs travel regardless; Gerald has connections

curiosity_stall.law1_rule: items whose salience floored still exist — c_phi never releases them. The stall sells the past.

curiosity_stall.availability: an item appears ONLY if the player's replay strip contains its source event — the stall is a mirror, not a menu
